rationale: Correct the existing Zeem Solutions record in place rather than adding the duplicate ArcLight owner proposed by the census queue. ArcLight Capital resolves to the existing canonical ArcLight Capital Partners ownership period. ArcLight's current investments page lists Zeem as Current, its 2025 ESG report attributes Zeem to Fund VII, and the July 2022 company release ties a $50 million investment to an ArcLight-managed fund and infrastructure strategy. Zeem's current official pages establish a 2017 founding year, Los Angeles headquarters, legal identity and continuing operations. Public sources do not disclose ArcLight's ownership percentage, security class, immediate holding vehicle or exact legal closing date. The 2022 release described LAZ Parking Realty Investors prospectively as an equity partner, but no legal closing or current direct ownership evidence was identified, so LPRI is not added. No Zeem-level sale, completed exit or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 15, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Zeem Solutions, Inc. designs, owns and operates commercial electric-vehicle charging infrastructure and provides fleet-management and EV-asset services for commercial fleets. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Los Angeles, the company operates shared charging depots in Inglewood and Long Beach, California, and SeaTac, Washington, while also deploying charging at customer sites. ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII committed $50 million in 2022, and ArcLight continues to list Zeem as a current transformative-infrastructure investment. Public sources do not disclose ArcLight's ownership percentage, security class, immediate holding vehicle or exact legal closing date. LAZ Parking Realty Investors was announced as a prospective strategic and equity partner in 2022, but no legal closing or current direct ownership evidence was identified; no Zeem-level sale or signed pending exit was found through August 15, 2026.
